_readme: Analytics parity file, version 1. It pins what the server AnalyticsService computes for the invented seed rows below, for month start days 1 and 25 and the listed 'today' values. It never changes: a change in behaviour is a new parity-v2.json, never an edit of this file. Producer and judge: backend AnalyticsParityIT (tag integration; regenerate scenarios only with MASROOF_PARITY_GENERATE=1). Consumer: the Android unit tests of eg.masroof.core.analytics (STORY-178/179). Layout is in fixtures/analytics/README.md. Amounts are integer minor units (piasters, EGP), ratios are integer basis points, all dates are Africa/Cairo, arrays are ordered and the order is part of the expectation.
